title: Admission Counselor
description:
**Company:** IPCS Global  
**Location:** Kochi  
**Salary:** ₹18,000 – ₹25,000 per month  
**Experience:** Minimum 1 year of experience in an EdTech firm is mandatory  
**Job Type:** Full\-time

Job Overview

IPCS Global is looking for a motivated and student\-focused **Academic Counselor** to join our team in Kochi. The candidate will be responsible for counseling students and parents, handling inquiries, generating leads, following up with prospective students, and converting leads into admissions.

Key Responsibilities

* Counsel students and parents regarding courses, career opportunities, and educational programs.
* Handle walk\-in, telephone, WhatsApp, and online inquiries.
* Understand student requirements and recommend suitable courses.
* Generate leads through inquiries, referrals, and promotional activities.
* Conduct regular follow\-ups with prospective students.
* Convert qualified leads into admissions.
* Achieve monthly admission and sales targets.
* Maintain accurate student and lead information in the CRM.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with students and parents.
* Participate in seminars, workshops, and promotional activities.
* Prepare regular follow\-up, lead, and admission reports.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure a smooth admission process.

Requirements \& Skills

* **Minimum 1 year of experience in an EdTech firm is mandatory.**
* Prior experience in **Academic Counseling, Admission Counseling, Inside Sales, or Student Counseling** is preferred.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong counseling, convincing, and negotiation skills.
* Good sales and follow\-up abilities.
* Target\-oriented and self\-motivated.
* Strong relationship management skills.
* Good listening and problem\-solving abilities.
* Empathetic and student\-focused approach.
* Basic knowledge of CRM systems and educational programs.

Pay: ₹18,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Customer Service Executive
description:
**Organization:** KLM Axiva Finvest ltd

We are seeking an experienced and motivated **Branch staff** to do our branch operations at **Ernakulam Region**. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in the NBFC or financial services sector, excellent leadership skills, and a passion for achieving business goals while ensuring superior customer service.

**Vacant Branches: Kalady, Banerji Road, Pallimukku, Palarivattom,Udayamperoor, Muvattupuzha, Fort Kochi, Kakkanad etc.** 

**Candidate Requirements:**

* Minimum 6 months experience in an NBFC or similar financial institution
* Exceptional customer service skills with the ability to handle customer queries effectively
* Ability to manage daily branch operations and ensure smooth workflow
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to guide and assist walk\-in customers with professionalism
* Good understanding of financial products, lending operations, and market dynamics

**Why Join KLM Axiva Finvest Ltd:**

* Opportunity to lead and grow a branch in a reputed NBFC
* Performance\-driven growth and career advancement
* Professional work environment with strong organizational support

Pay: ₹13,000\.00 \- ₹18,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
